profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at MyFitnessPal
profile.summary: I am a software engineer who enjoys learning new skills and applying them to complex problems. Software development is more than a profession, it is a tool that has a profound impact on every aspect of our lives. I am constantly seeking opportunities to apply my own knowledge to these advancements, while further developing my skills.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead for the Logging and Image Team. Responsible for coaching, mentoring, and collaborating with a team of backend engineers to build and maintain high throughput services and foster career growth for all team members.

Maintain and extend a diary service that handles 500 million requests per day and supports the logging and tracking of foods, meals, exercises, and water consumption for over 200 million MyFitnessPal users.

On-call rotation member responsible for the triage, debugging, and incident response for roughly 100 backend services within the MyFitnessPal eco-system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained a feed service that supports and drives social feeds across Connected Fitness applications.

Maintained and extended a notification platform that delivers user and marketing messages (email, push, in-app) to over 200 million users across all Connected Fitness applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as Technical Lead during the design and implementation of RESTful Web Services with JAX-RS, as well as full stack development using MEAN (Mongo, Express, AngularJS, NodeJS) stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Intern
positions.description: Developed an internal web application that tracked company assets and employee statistics.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description: Designed and developed all computer based psychology experiments (with E-Basic) for the John Wixted Laboratory, lead research center for the university’s psychology department.

company.name: University of California, San Diego - Department of Psychology
